source: Written by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) from the county counts (AP via The New York Times), the 2024 baseline and Census ACS 2023 context.

15003.t:
In the race for governor between Josh Green (D) and Gary Cordery (R), Honolulu County gave Green 179,144 votes to Cordery's 69,851, a 44-point margin. Kamala Harris carried the county by 22 points in 2024, so it moved 22 points toward the Democrats, the same as the statewide shift. That ranks second of Hawaii's four counties, all of which moved left. Kauai moved most, by 29 points, while Maui and Hawaii counties each moved about 21. Nationally, the typical county moved 14 points left.

Honolulu cast 248,995 votes, the most in the state but only 73% of its 340,921 in 2024. With turnout that much lower, the count cannot tell voters who changed their minds from those who stayed home.

15009.t:
In the governor's race, Maui County backed Green over Cordery 35,946 to 13,164, a 46-point Democratic margin, up from Harris's 26-point edge in 2024. That 21-point move toward the Democrats was the smallest of Hawaii's four counties, all of which moved left: Kauai moved 29 points, Honolulu 22 and Hawaii County 21. It still outpaced the typical county nationally, which moved 14 points left.

Turnout was far lower, at 49,110 votes, or 78% of the 62,893 cast in 2024. With that many fewer voters, the count cannot tell whether people changed their minds or some simply stayed home.

15007.t:
Kauai County gave Josh Green (D) a 48-point win over Gary Cordery (R) in the governor's race, 17,694 votes to 6,169. In 2024, Kamala Harris carried it by about 20 points. That 29-point move toward the Democrats was the largest of Hawaii's four counties, ahead of Honolulu (22), Hawaii County (21) and Maui (21), and well above the statewide move of 22 and the typical national move of 14.

Turnout fell sharply. About 23,863 votes were cast, 79% of the 30,064 counted in 2024. With that many fewer voters, the count cannot tell who changed their mind from who stayed home. With 99% of the expected vote counted, these figures are close to final.

15001.t:
In the race for governor, Hawaii County gave Josh Green (D) 45,868 votes to Gary Cordery (R) 15,742, a 49-point Democratic margin. Kamala Harris carried the county by 28 points in 2024, so it moved 21 points toward the Democrats. That is close to the statewide move of 22 and to the typical Hawaii county's 21. It ranks third of four counties by move: Maui moved 21 points, Honolulu 22 and Kauai 29. Nationally, the typical county moved 14 points left.

The county cast 61,610 votes, 74% of its 2024 total. With turnout that much lower, the count cannot tell voters who changed their minds from those who stayed home.
